description: Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority - Notify the Rules cited as "The Tourism (Licensing Tourist Enterprises and Tourist Services) Rules"
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority under the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005. It establishes regulatory procedures for licensing tourist enterprises and tourist services, including application requirements, inspection processes, and monitoring activities. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves subsidiary legislation and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
